messages.subject: Multinomial Log-Normal Distribution
parts:
Hello.

I would like to make sampling from a multinomial log-normal distribution. 
In particular,

vector[K] y[N];
vector[K] Mu[N];
matrix[K,K] Sigma[N];
for (n in 1:N)
    y[n] ~lognormal(Mu[n], Sigma[n]);

However, the lognormal function does not support for the multinomial case. 

I suppose I can do:
log(y[n]) ~ multi_normal(Mu[n], Sigma[n]);
increment_log_prob(...);

However, it would be very complicated to compute a Jacobian matrix, i.e. the inside of the bracket for increment_log_prob...
Is there any simple way to carry out this sampling?

Your kind assistance is highly appreciated.

Best regards,
Tom
